dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge follows a nearly linear spline with negligible concave curvature visible only at the basal insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification characterized by a sharp, low-pixel-radius terminal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin, measured at approximately 75-80 degrees relative to the dorsal longitudinal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: High verticality; the maximum pixel base width is approximately 0.55 to 0.60 times the maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, shallow convex curve with a large radius fitting the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and robust beak; the visible length from the inflection point is approximately equal to the thickness of the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable obtuse angle of approximately 140 degrees at the specific pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, well-defined circular ring-shaped scar is visible on the lateral flank posterior to the eye; multiple smaller, irregular light-colored punctate marks are scattered along the lower lateral region.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme pixel saturation and high-contrast luminescence along the dorsal ridge and lateral midline, creating a glowing silhouette effect against the dark background.
